Question: In how many of the following four relations is $y$ a function of $x$? ① $y=|x|$; ② $x=y^2$; ③ $y=1/x$; ④ $x^2+y^2=4$. (Enter only a number.)
Solution: ① Each value of $x$ corresponds to a unique value of $y$, so it is a function. ② When $x>0$, it corresponds to two values of $y$, so it is not a function. ③ When $x\ne0$, $y$ is unique, so it is a function. ④ When $x=1$, $y=\pm\sqrt{3}$, so it is not a function. Therefore, only ① and ③ are functions, giving 2 in total.
